ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: IF( ISBLANK(Email), TRUE, AND( OR( REGEX(LOWER(Email), ".*\\.(games|garden|glass|free|talk)$"), REGEX(LOWER(Email), "^(info@|contact@|career@).*") ), FIND("a", Email, 5) > 0, FIND("a", Email, 5) <= 12 ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Invalid Email Address: Domain extensions (.games, .garden, .glass, .free, .talk) and generic email prefixes (info@, contact@, career@) are not allowed.
